name: SerializeJSON
label: Serialize JSON Token
description: Converts a JToken or object into both JSON string and JToken.

fields.name: InputToken
fields.label: Input Token
fields.description: The JToken or object to serialize into JSON text.

fields.name: SerializedJson
fields.label: Serialized JSON
fields.description: The resulting JSON string from serialization. Returns null if serialization failed.

fields.name: SerializedToken
fields.label: Serialized Token
fields.description: The resulting JToken from serialization. Returns null if serialization failed.
